frozen_modules_and_their_actual_types.note: no frozen module was edited, rebuilt or re-reviewed to produce this correction; the types below are quoted from audit/D135Audit.lean output (results/logs/audit_run4.log)

types.name: Linear.Feasible
types.type: (S : LinearSystem ι κ) → (z : κ → ℚ) → Prop
types.meaning: box and declared rows hold at a RATIONAL assignment

types.name: nonneg_combination_sound
types.type: ∀ {ι κ} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (S : LinearSystem ι κ) (w : ι → ℤ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → combRhs S w < boxMin S w → ∀ (z : κ → ℚ), ¬ Feasible S z

types.name: nonnegCheck_sound
types.type: ∀ {ι κ} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (S : LinearSystem ι κ) (w : ι → ℤ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → nonnegCheck S w = true → ∀ (z : κ → ℚ), ¬ Feasible S z

types.name: interval_terminal_sound
types.type: ∀ {κ} [Fintype κ] (a : κ → ℤ) (b : ℤ) (lo hi : κ → ℤ), (∀ j, lo j ≤ hi j) → b < ∑ j, min (a j * lo j) (a j * hi j) → ∀ (z : κ → ℚ), (∀ j, ↑(lo j) ≤ z j ∧ z j ≤ ↑(hi j)) → ∑ j, ↑(a j) * z j ≤ ↑b → False

types.name: height_terminal_sound
types.type: ∀ {κ} [Fintype κ] (a h : κ → ℚ) (B t α : ℚ) (lo hi : κ → ℚ), (∀ j, lo j ≤ hi j) → 0 < t → B - ∑ j, min ((a j - t * h j) * lo j) ((a j - t * h j) * hi j) ≤ t * α → ∀ (z : κ → ℚ), (∀ j, lo j ≤ z j ∧ z j ≤ hi j) → ∑ j, a j * z j ≤ B → ∑ j, h j * z j ≤ α
types.scope: rational assignments only; it is a SAFETY statement (F ≤ α), never an empty-source statement

types.name: Rational.Feasible
types.type: (S : Rational.RatSystem ι κ) → (z : κ → ℚ) → Prop
types.meaning: box and declared rows hold at a RATIONAL assignment

types.name: Rational.nonneg_combination_sound
types.type: ∀ {ι κ} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (S : Rational.RatSystem ι κ) (w : ι → ℚ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → Rational.combRhs S w < Rational.boxMin S w → ∀ (z : κ → ℚ), ¬ Rational.Feasible S z

types.name: Rational.check_sound
types.type: ∀ {ι κ} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (S : Rational.RatSystem ι κ) (w : ι → ℚ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → Rational.check S w = true → ∀ (z : κ → ℚ), ¬ Rational.Feasible S z
